Ticket:
Help with tracking insurance claim denials and pulling reports

Hi team, I am looking at our denial management tools and I am a bit lost. We are trying to figure out how to pull reports on specific denial reason codes so we can address recurring billing issues with a few major payers, but the reporting dashboard has so many filters that I'm not sure which ones apply to appeals. Also, when we attach clinical notes to a denied claim, is there a way to make sure it links directly to the appeal form? Any screenshots or simple steps would be great.
